title_zh: 首批救援队伍抵达吉隆口岸核心位置，开展排查搜救
title_en: First Rescue Team Arrives at Core Area of Gyirong Port for Search and Rescue
summary_zh: 2026年8月28日，首批救援队伍抵达西藏吉隆口岸核心位置，开展排查搜救。此前吉隆发生泥石流，已致5人遇难、558人失联。
summary_en: On August 28, 2026, the first batch of rescue teams arrived at the core area of Gyirong Port in Tibet to conduct search and rescue operations. A previous mudslide there left 5 dead and 558 missing.
